cover_headline: Nasdaq Tumbles 2.6% as Oil Surge and AI Spending Fears Hit Stocks
facts: The Nasdaq Composite dropped 2.60% to 26,008.86, its steepest daily decline since June, while the S&P 500 fell 1.21% to 7,663.43
Brent crude futures rose 3% to settle at $113.03 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate advanced 2.18% to $99.27
Meta Platforms fell around 7% despite reporting better-than-expected third-quarter revenue and an upbeat outlook

quote.text: Concerns about the sustainability of AI spending hurt markets and rising oil prices stoked concerns about the threat posed by inflation.
quote.speaker: Russ Mould

end.headline: Nasdaq Tumbles 2.6% as Oil Surge and AI Spending Fears Hit Stocks
end.line: The Nasdaq suffered its worst day since June as Brent topped $113, Meta slid on AI costs, and investors fled to Treasuries.
